access_model.notes: SPI full-duplex 3-byte transaction per channel. TX: [0x01, start_sgl_diff|(ch<<4), 0x00]. RX: [0x00, data_high_2bits|zero, data_low_8bits]. Result = ((rx[1] & 0x03) << 8) | rx[2], range 0-1023.

operation_flows.description: SPI read of a single channel in single-ended mode

transaction.notes: TX frame: start bit + single-ended CH0 command + dummy byte

steps.notes: Control byte 0x80 = start(1) + SGL/DIFF(1 for single-ended) + D2(0) + D1(0) + D0(0) for CH0

transaction.notes: RX frame: [dummy, dataH|zeros, dataL]. 10-bit result = ((byte1 & 0x03) << 8) | byte2

steps.notes: First byte is zero (dummy), data in bytes 1 (top 2 bits) and 2 (low 8 bits)

registers_or_commands.name: SPI_READ_COMMAND
registers_or_commands.description: 3-byte SPI frame: byte0=0x01 (start bit), byte1=0x80|(channel<<4) (SGL/DIFF+D2+D1+D0), byte2=0x00 (dummy). Returns 3 bytes: byte0=dummy, byte1[1:0]=ADC[9:8], byte2=ADC[7:0].

init_sequence.notes: Power-up: apply V_DD and V_REF. Ensure CS is high initially.
If CS was low during power-up, bring CS high then low to initiate communication.

transaction.notes: Send start bit (1), SGL/DIFF, D2, D1, D0; then read null bit + 10 data bits

read_sequence.notes: Total of 15 clocks: start bit, 4 config bits, null bit, 10 data bits. Data output on falling edge.

error_conditions.condition: CS not held low during entire conversion
error_conditions.detection: CS rising edge during conversion aborts conversion
error_conditions.driver_action: Ensure CS remains low for entire 15-clock cycle conversion

error_conditions.detection: Effective clock rate below 10 kHz may cause charge loss on sample capacitor

power_states.name: standby
power_states.description: CS high, device in low-power standby

evidence_spans.snippet: The first clock received with CS low and D_IN high will constitute a start bit.
The SGL/DIFF bit follows the start bit and will determine if the conversion will be done using single-ended or differential input mode.
The next three bits (D0, D1 and D2) are used to select the input channel configuration.
On the falling edge of the next clock, the device will output a low null bit.
The next 10 clocks will output the result of the conversion with MSB first.

CS/SHDN pin is used to initiate communication with the device when pulled low.
When pulled high, it will end a conversion and put the device in low-power standby.
The CS/SHDN pin must be pulled high between conversions.
The MCP3004/3008 A/D converters employ a conventional SAR architecture.
a sample is acquired on an internal sample/hold capacitor for 1.5 clock cycles
The MCP3008 can be configured to provide four pseudo-differential input pairs or eight single-ended inputs.
